title: Prompt Context Pack Map
purpose: Data-only seed map that defines how LLMGameCreator should assemble small, relevant prompt context packs for model workflows without dumping the whole project, repository or lore into every request.
principles: Context is a selected artifact, not an accidental full project dump.
Every model request should declare role, task kind, artifact contract, expected output schema and allowed context sources.
Designer prompts may include broader lore and discussion history; batch generation prompts must include only the minimal contract, rules, enums, relevant facts and examples required for one artifact.
Prompt context packs are data-only and traceable: each included section should identify source, reason, freshness and token budget class.
Large lore is reduced into canonical summaries, section summaries and tagged snippets before it reaches small batch models.
Adult/NSFW context is included only when the active game profile explicitly enables the corresponding content overlay; it remains tagged, filterable and export-aware.
Repair prompts must include the original input, invalid output, validation report and the exact contract; they must not invite unrelated redesign.
Context selectors may use deterministic tags first and optional model-assisted ranking only for ambiguous/high-value tasks.

budget_classes.purpose: Strict repair, one small JSON artifact, enum-preserving normalization or targeted scoring.
Single artifact generation with schema, rules, few examples and relevant project snippets.
Batch generation, semantic pack expansion, profile-scoped design tasks or multi-artifact consistency checks.
High-level design discussion, complex profile negotiation, canon consolidation or architecture planning.

context_source_types.summary: Active game profile, runtime targets, required feature bundles and content overlays.
Exact contract that the model must produce or repair.
JSON schema or compact shape definition for strict structured output.
Allowed ids, enum values and fields that must be copied exactly.
Canonical compressed summary of lore, rules, style, mechanics and user decisions.
Relevant snippets selected by domain, capability, artifact contract, tags and active profile.
Few-shot examples or negative examples for one contract. Must be short and representative.
Structured validation errors, warnings and repair targets.
Compact summary or dedupe set from prior generated artifacts; never unbounded full logs.
Adult/NSFW, horror/gore or other overlay rules only when explicitly enabled by profile.

pack_templates.title: Strict Single JSON Artifact Pack
must_not_include: permission to invent new canon facts unless requested

pack_templates.title: Batch Generation Round-Robin Pack
must_include: small compact memory of prior outputs

pack_templates.title: Targeted Repair Pack
expected_outputs: repaired version of the same artifact contract

selection_pipeline.goal: Determine role, artifact contract, game profile, runtime target and whether content overlays are enabled.
Collect candidate context sections from profile, contracts, schemas, enums, summaries, snippets, examples, prior outputs and validation reports.
Drop disabled overlays, stale drafts, unapproved canon, irrelevant runtime targets and unrelated domains.
Rank by exact contract match, capability tags, entity ids, validation targets, profile requirements and freshness.
Fit selected context into the role budget by preferring schemas/enums/rules over verbose lore and using summaries before raw snippets.
Render a traceable prompt pack with sections, source ids, reasons, constraints and expected output instructions.
Store prompt pack metadata, source list, token estimate and output validation result for debugging and repair loops.

priority_rules: Required artifact contract and schema beat lore.
Validation failure targets beat generic context.
Approved canon beats generated draft facts.
Profile-enabled overlays beat disabled overlay snippets; disabled overlay snippets must be excluded.
Summaries beat raw long text unless exact wording is required.
Recent explicit user decisions beat older inferred preferences.
anti_patterns: Dumping entire repository or all JSON files into every prompt.
Using previous model outputs as trusted facts without validation/promotion.
Mixing several artifact contracts in one strict output request.
Giving the batch model broad creative permission while expecting enum-perfect JSON.
Including adult/NSFW context when the active project/profile did not enable that overlay.
Repair prompts that ask the model to rewrite the whole system instead of fixing exact validation failures.
Letting context grow linearly with every generated item.

trace_record_shape.notes: Trace records are metadata for debugging, reproducibility and repair; they do not store unrestricted private chat dumps by default.
